title: playwright-mcp-server
description: Headless browser primitives for AI agents when sites need real JS rendering.
summary: Headless browser primitives for AI agents when sites need real JS rendering.
offersHint: Headless browser primitives for AI agents when sites need real JS rendering. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://nexgendata-mcp-proxy.steve-corbeil.workers.dev/playwright-mcp-server/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Apify API token. Free tier at console.apify.com

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Apify API token. Free tier at console.apify.com

toolsPreview.name: navigate
toolsPreview.description: Navigate the browser to a URL. Returns the final URL and page title.

toolsPreview.name: screenshot
toolsPreview.description: Take a PNG screenshot of the current page (or a specific element). Returns base64 PNG.

toolsPreview.name: click
toolsPreview.description: Click an element matched by CSS selector or visible text.

toolsPreview.name: type_text
toolsPreview.description: Type text into an input/textarea. Optionally clear first or press Enter after.

toolsPreview.name: get_text
toolsPreview.description: Extract visible text from the page or a specific element.

toolsPreview.name: get_html
toolsPreview.description: Return the HTML of the page or a specific element.

toolsPreview.name: evaluate
toolsPreview.description: Evaluate JavaScript in the page context. Use `return` for values or an expression.

toolsPreview.name: select_option
toolsPreview.description: Choose an option from a <select> element by value or visible label.

toolsPreview.name: scroll
toolsPreview.description: Scroll the page (or an element) in the given direction by `amount` pixels.

toolsPreview.name: wait_for
toolsPreview.description: Wait until a selector reaches a given state (visible|hidden|attached|detached).

toolsPreview.name: get_links
toolsPreview.description: Collect all anchor hrefs, optionally filtered by regex.

toolsPreview.name: extract_table
toolsPreview.description: Extract a standard HTML table as a list of row objects keyed by header.

toolsPreview.name: page_pdf
toolsPreview.description: Render the current page as PDF (headless only). Returns base64 PDF.

toolsPreview.name: fill_form
toolsPreview.description: Fill multiple form fields from a list of {selector, value} and optionally submit.

toolsPreview.name: get_cookies
toolsPreview.description: Return all cookies for the current browser context.

toolsPreview.name: set_cookies
toolsPreview.description: Set cookies for the current browser context.

toolsPreview.name: close_browser
toolsPreview.description: Close the underlying browser, freeing resources.
